Job Description: 
 
 DXC Technology Italy is looking for a Software Developer Consultant to join the Custom Application Offering.
 
 Responsibilities 
 Autonomously design, develop and execute business and technical software solutions to implement new or enhanced applications (upgrades or conversions)
 Analyze, identify and resolve business and/or technical problems using appropriate solutions and tools
 Act as a direct point of contact with Business Analysts and Project Managers to understand the business environment, technical context and organizational strategic direction
 Contribute to the definition and maintenance of development standards and best practices within the team
 Provide guidance and support to junior developers on delivery activities
 Stay current on emerging tools, techniques, and technologies
 
 We Require 
 Bachelor or Master Degree (a technical field such as Computer Science, Computer Engineering, etc. is a plus)
 Experience and knowledge of Digital Development Services, Agile Application Development, DevOps, Cloud-based applications and Microservices architecture and patterns
 Strong technical experience writing code using languages: Java EE, Spring Framework (Core, MVC, Security, Data, Boot, etc.), Single Page Application frameworks, Microservices, Docker, design patterns and architecture design, and SQL/NoSQL databases
 Knowledge of AI/ML technologies, such as cloud AI services, LLM platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI), basic ML frameworks and integration of AI APIs into enterprise applications.
 Knowledge of software development processes (Agile, Waterfall) and DevOps
 Ability to work with web-development tools for new applications with use of AI-assisted engineering tools
 Solid understanding of modern software design and development methodologies
 
 The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, a problem-solving mindset, a focus on results, sound decision-making skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
 
 Location: Bari (BA), with Smart Working possibility.
 
 Why Join Us 
 
 Offer Package 
 The position offers a gross annual base salary starting from €20,000.
 Compensation is determined in line with the applicable collective labor agreement (CBA: Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per il personale dipendente da imprese esercenti servizi di telecomunicazione) and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including responsibility, experience and skills.
 Health Insurance
 Permanent disability by accident coverage
 Meal vouchers
 Supplemental Pension Plan
 Smart Working Agreement
 Employee Discounts Program
 
 Continuous Learning — Access learning platforms and take part in skill development programs designed for you.
 
 Refer & Earn — Help us find great talent through the Employee Referral Program and get rewarded for your contribution.
 
 Career Development — DXC promotes professional growth and internal mobility by making every open position accessible to all employees. Through the Performance Development program, the company supports individual aspirations to achieve shared goals together.
 
 Our Way of Working — At DXC, we believe that strong connections and collaboration drive success. Our hybrid work model combines flexibility with in-person teamwork, empowering you to perform at your best while maintaining balance and wellbeing.
 


 #LI-Hybrid 

 
 At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. 
 
 
 Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is available   here .
